scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build:full: pnpm run build:application && pnpm run build:sites
scripts.build:application: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run build
scripts.lint: prettier --check package.json scripts/lib/dependency-hygiene.mjs scripts/lib/import-extension-policy.mjs scripts/legacy-format-ratchet.mjs scripts/normalize-node-imports.mjs scripts/rewrite-generated-zod-v4.mjs scripts/test/dependency-hygiene.test.mjs scripts/test/import-extension-policy.test.mjs scripts/test/legacy-sync-inventory.test.mjs scripts/test/openapi-codegen-contract.test.mjs scripts/test/phase-one-governance.test.mjs scripts/test/zod-import-boundary.test.mjs scripts/test/zod-semantics-characterization.test.mjs lib/api-spec/orval.config.ts && pnpm run lint:legacy
scripts.test:front-office: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:front-office && pnpm --filter @workspace/alpha-crm-sync run test:front-office
scripts.test:full: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:front-office && pnpm run test:security && pnpm run test:refactoring && pnpm run test:sites && pnpm run test:e2e-preflight
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter @workspace/sites-control --if-present run typecheck
